ordered_diagnoses: Melanoma metastatic to the liver with epithelioid morphology

s1.syndrome_frame: Incidental hepatic tumors in a middle-aged woman with abnormal liver function tests and characteristic imaging and histopathological findings
salient_findings: Multiple heterogeneous masses in both lobes of the liver
Uneven arterial enhancement and washout in the portal venous and delayed phases on CT
Epithelioid tumor cells with moderate nuclear atypia and focal intracytoplasmic melanin pigments on biopsy
key_facts: Hepatic tumors found incidentally during routine check-up
Denies abdominal pain, weight loss, or anorexia
No medical history of liver disease
Smokes 2-5 cigarettes daily for ten years
Abdomen soft and non-tender without ascites
Tumor markers (AFP, CEA, CA19-9, CA125) within normal limits
Immunohistochemical staining positive for HMB45, Melan-A, SOX10, and BRAF V600E

shortlist.label: Metastatic melanoma to the liver
shortlist.why_kept: Immunohistochemical staining positive for HMB45, Melan-A, SOX10, and BRAF V600E, and presence of melanin pigments

shortlist.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Incidental hepatic tumors with abnormal liver function tests and characteristic imaging findings

shortlist.label: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Epithelioid tumor cells with moderate nuclear atypia and focal intracytoplasmic melanin pigments in solid nests infiltrating the parenchyma

shortlist.label: Hepatic angiomyolipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Heterogeneous masses in both lobes of the liver with uneven arterial enhancement and washout in the portal venous and delayed phases

shortlist.label: Melanoma metastatic to the liver with epithelioid morphology
shortlist.why_kept: Similar to metastatic melanoma, with epithelioid morphology and positive immunohistochemical staining for melanoma markers

raw.rationale: The patient's liver biopsy showed epithelioid tumor cells with focal intracytoplasmic melanin pigments and immunohistochemical staining positive for HMB45, Melan-A, SOX10, and BRAF V600E, which are characteristic markers for melanoma.

rejected.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
rejected.why: The patient's tumor markers (AFP) were within normal limits and the immunohistochemical staining did not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: The patient's biopsy and immunohistochemical staining results do not support this diagnosis, which typically shows positivity for CD31, CD34, and ERG.

rejected.label: Hepatic angiomyolipoma
rejected.why: The patient's biopsy results showed epithelioid tumor cells with melanin pigments, which is not consistent with the typical histological features of angiomyolipoma, such as the presence of adipocytes, smooth muscle cells, and blood vessels.

rejected.label: Melanoma metastatic to the liver with epithelioid morphology
rejected.why: This option is essentially the same as the chosen champion, metastatic melanoma to the liver, as the epithelioid morphology is a characteristic feature of the tumor cells in this case.
